knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The manual requires replacement of corroded or bent components, which can otherwise blow off under pressure.
The manual permits silicone grease or soapy solution and forbids petroleum-based products.
The manual advises a dry or weatherproof location and warns that wrapping the motor in plastic can trap condensation.

practicalCriteria: Each component is inspected and each finding is recorded with a decision to keep, replace or refer
Valve top replacement follows the stated order, uses the correct lubricant and is tightened in a crossing sequence without over-tightening
Pressure is shown to be relieved before service begins
Shutdown steps are recorded against the operator's written instruction
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Inspection and replacement record from one supervised service
Photo of the valve seal surface where the owner agrees
stopWorkCriteria: Petroleum-based lubricant used on valve parts
Over-tightened valve top or a cracked component left in service
Motor wrapped in plastic or non-propylene-glycol antifreeze used
